propositions: FAIL remediation guidance states that ticket-comment evidence will be considered on retry but omits the exact [operator-attested] tag prerequisite required for external criteria.
Untagged external criteria are classified as codebase-verifiable by design and cannot be satisfied by ticket comments alone, per ADR 0043.
The mismatch between generic remediation wording and strict tag enforcement causes operators to follow incomplete guidance and incur futile verifier retries.
Remediation guidance must affirmatively distinguish repository-verifiable evidence from external operator-attested evidence and name the exact tag prerequisite.
The strengthened interface test requires the exact [operator-attested] tag and the untagged-external limitation; existing test was RED before the fix and GREEN after.
